messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning an RBAC rollout that adds an `audit_read` scope. Wanted to surface potential audit-event churn and validation concerns.
leo: Adding `audit_read` will cause more UI-driven read events (list preview, policy checks). We should expect ~25-40% increase in event volume during rollout window.
jamal: Can we avoid full indexing for those extra reads? Dynamic per-tenant sampling based on plan + recent activity sounds right.
anika: Also flag: KMS envelope rotates next week. That changes `kms_key_id` on events. Do we currently index key ids or treat as metadata? If indexed, rotations will spike writes.
maria: Proposal: schema evolution should keep new fields optional. Example patch we can push:
```json
{"event_type":"access","actor":{"id":"u_123","role":"viewer"},"target":{"id":"t_456"},"meta":{"kms_key_id":"optional","rbac_diff":"optional"}}
```
leo: Nice. For throughput concerns, producer-side batching helps a lot. We're seeing bursts up to ~6k EPS per region; batching window of 50-100ms cuts broker churn.
ops-bot: ALERT: kafka topic `audit-events` lag > 100k for 10m — autoscaler triggered (scale +2 partitions).
jamal: If lag continues, fallback plan: switch to sampled indexing (store full raw events in cold S3 + light index with sampled docs for search). That keeps downstream costs bounded while preserving full audit trail.
anika: Cost snapshot for planning: indexing + transforms for 1M events ~ $45 (including ES ops + ingest lambda). Pure storage for raw events ~ $3.5. If we can sample 70% of reads into light index we save ~30-35% overall.
maria: We also need a customer-facing validation endpoint so customers can validate their expected audit schema before we flip RBAC. Think webhook `POST /audit/validate` that accepts a sample event and returns conformance + warnings (e.g., missing optional fields, KMS key presence).
leo: I'll prototype producer sampling config + small PR for optional `meta.kms_key_id` in schema.
jamal: I'll model cost thresholds and a circuit that enables auto-sample when Kafka lag > X or indexing cost > Y per minute.
anika: I'll add a runbook note about KMS rotations — ensure that rotation metadata is only in `meta` not a tokenized searchable field.
maria: Action items: 1) opt-in tenant flag for verbose audit; 2) transient sampling trigger (lag/cost-based); 3) webhook for customer schema validation; 4) doc runbook for KMS rotation impact. Tagging @jamal @anika for follow-ups.
leo: Thanks, starting on the PR.
maria: :thumbsup:
